title: 第25章 混沌之环第26章 蚍蜉
lines: 三色星焰与混沌洪流轰然相撞，爆发出撕裂维度的巨响。
核心空间被纯粹的能量风暴席卷，炽白锋刃切割黑暗，幽绿星尘湮灭物质，深邃暗影吞噬着逸散的能量。
混沌洪流如同亿万疯狂巨兽，咆哮着要将这亵渎的存在彻底碾碎。
星辉之龙悬浮在风暴中心，双翼怒张，源源不断喷涌着三重伟力。
它的身躯在能量对冲中剧烈震颤，暗影鳞片不断撕裂剥落，又在星辉与星尘的流转下急速修复。
左眼的秩序之火冰冷燃烧，精准引导攻势；右眼的星尘暗影翻滚着狂野的兴奋，驱动着毁灭的力量。
混沌意志的黑洞投影在冲击中疯狂旋转，每一次明灭都带来更狂暴的反扑。
液态黑暗的空间壁障被撕扯出蛛网般的裂痕，外界的归墟乱流疯狂涌入，被卷入这场毁灭盛宴。
“秩序…混沌…悖逆…必须抹除！”
黑洞投影的轰鸣带着惊怒与动摇。
它无法理解这融合体为何能在它的核心腹地开辟出遵循自身规则的领域，并疯狂汲取它的力量。
恐怖的僵持持续着。
星辉之龙虽然强大，但面对无穷无尽的混沌本源，它的力量开始显现颓势，三色星焰正以肉眼可见的速度黯淡。
就在此时，一道微弱却纯粹的精神波动穿透能量风暴，传入卡拉斯的灵魂烙印——是青铜龙逆鳞粉末中蕴含的守护执念残响！
这残响如同一道坐标，指向混沌洪流深处一个隐蔽而关键的节点！
卡拉斯冰冷的意志瞬间捕捉到信息。
他看到了——隐藏在黑暗洪流深处，一个散发着与束缚暗爪的锁链同源气息的“混沌之结”
“暗爪！
左翼倾泻！
目标七点钟方向，混沌之结！”
没有丝毫犹豫，暗爪的野性意志瞬间响应。
星辉之龙左翼猛地振动，超过七成的狂暴能量被压缩成一道凝练的三色毁灭光束，精准射向隐藏的节点！
混沌意志察觉危机，发出尖啸试图回防，但为时已晚。
凝练的光束如同烧红的钢针穿透朽木，精准命中目标。
“咔嚓！”
清脆的碎裂声在轰鸣中微不足道，却清晰可闻。
混沌之结碎了！
如同推倒多米诺骨牌，黑暗洪流瞬间失去统御，结构崩塌，能量陷入混乱无序的冲突湮灭。
黑洞投影发出痛苦的尖啸，形态剧烈扭曲，威压暴跌。
机会来临！
“就是现在！”
卡拉斯与暗爪的意志高度统一。
星辉之龙右翼积蓄的力量轰然爆发，化作无数道三色交织的能量锁链，带着融合体的本源烙印，无视混乱的洪流，精准缠绕上陷入虚弱状态的黑洞投影！
“混沌之环！”
冰冷与狂野交织的咆哮响彻空间。
三色锁链深深勒入混沌能量构成的躯体，秩序之力灼烧其形态，星尘之力侵蚀其本源，暗影之力吞噬其力量。
黑洞投影疯狂挣扎，但失去力量核心的它如同被拔掉毒牙的巨蟒。
锁链越收越紧。
“不…可…能…归墟永恒…”
投影发出绝望嘶鸣。
“此环，即是归墟的伤痕！”
卡拉斯冰冷宣判。
星辉之龙双翼猛地合拢！
content_en:
The three-color star flame collided with the torrent of chaos, erupting with a loud noise that tore apart the dimension.
The core space was swept by a pure energy storm, with blazing white blades cutting through the darkness, green stardust annihilating matter, and deep shadows devouring the dissipated energy.
The torrent of chaos is like billions of crazy behemoths, roaring to completely crush this blasphemous existence.
The Dragon of Starlight was suspended in the center of the storm, its wings spread furiously, and it continuously spurted out triple power.
Its body trembled violently in the energy conflict, and its shadow scales were constantly torn and peeled off, and then quickly repaired under the flow of starlight and stardust.
The fire of order in the left eye burns coldly, accurately guiding the offensive; the stardust shadow in the right eye rolls with wild excitement, driving the power of destruction.
The black hole projection of the will of chaos spins wildly during the impact, and every time it lights up or dies, it brings about a more violent counterattack.
The space barrier of liquid darkness was torn out with spiderweb-like cracks, and the turbulent flow of returning ruins from the outside world rushed in crazily, and was involved in this feast of destruction.
"Order...chaos...disobedience...must be eradicated!"
The roar of the black hole projection was filled with shock, anger and shock.
It cannot understand why this fusion can carve out a domain that follows its own rules in its core hinterland and draw its power crazily.
The horrific stalemate continued.
Although the Star Dragon is powerful, in the face of the endless source of chaos, its power begins to show decline, and the three-color star flame is fading at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At this moment, a weak but pure spiritual wave penetrated the energy storm and passed into Karas's soul imprint - the reverberation of the guardian obsession contained in the bronze dragon reverse scale powder!
This reverberation is like a coordinate, pointing to a hidden and key node deep in the chaotic torrent!
Karas' cold will captured the information instantly.
He saw - hidden deep in the torrent of darkness, a "knot of chaos" that exuded the same aura as the chains that bound the Dark Claws.
“Dark Claw!
The left wing pours!
Target seven o'clock, the Knot of Chaos! "
Without any hesitation, Dark Claw's wild will responded instantly.
The left wing of the Star Dragon vibrated violently, and more than 70% of the violent energy was compressed into a condensed three-color beam of destruction, which was accurately shot at the hidden node!
The Chaos Will sensed the crisis and screamed in an attempt to defend itself, but it was too late.
The condensed beam penetrates the dead wood like a red-hot steel needle and hits the target accurately.
"Crack!"
The crisp cracking sound was insignificant in the roar, but it was clearly audible.
The knot of chaos is broken!
Like toppling dominoes, the dark torrent instantly lost its control, the structure collapsed, and the energy fell into chaotic and disorderly conflict and annihilation.
The black hole projection screamed in pain, its shape distorted violently, and its pressure plummeted.
The opportunity has come!
"Now!"
The wills of Karas and Darkclaw are highly unified.
The accumulated power of the Star Dragon's right wing exploded, turning into countless three-color energy chains, bearing the original imprint of the fusion body, ignoring the torrent of chaos, and accurately wrapping around the black hole projection that was in a weak state!
"Ring of Chaos!"
An icy and wild roar echoed through the space.
The three-color chain is deeply inserted into the body composed of chaotic energy. The power of order burns its form, the power of stardust erodes its origin, and the power of shadow swallows its strength.
The black hole projection struggled wildly, but without its core of power, it was like a python with its fangs pulled out.
The chains tightened tighter and tighter.
"Impossible...can...return to the ruins forever..."
The projection screamed in despair.
"This ring is the scar of Guixu!"
Karas delivered the verdict coldly.
The Star Dragon's wings suddenly closed together!
